run_pr_latency_measurement: run the script to measure CI test latency for recent open pull requests
run_pr_latency_csv: run the script with csv format to export PR latency data to a spreadsheet
get_pr_data: fetch the 100 most recent open pull requests from the GitHub API
get_status_data: retrieve CI status data for a given PR and filter by jenkins or kokoro system
parse_timestamp: parse an ISO 8601 datetime string into a Python datetime object
